verdict.rationale: Pendo treats accounts as a first-class entity: it can delete accounts and visitors via API, and Session Replay can be filtered by account or plan. That shows some native account-level slicing of behavior. However, nothing in the evidence documents account-level funnels, retention, or aggregated usage analytics, so the core of the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: documented account/company-level aggregation in analytics reports, account-level funnels and retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
